name: just-do-it
description: Portable PRD delivery with validated least-privilege agent teams, restart-safe continuity, and explicit forge gates.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate, reconcile, review, and deliver complex work safely.
interface.longDescription: JD turns one goal into PRDs and bounded model-tiered tasks, reconciles durable event checkpoints, enforces independent review and explicit forge authority, and offers a scoped, expiring break-glass capability grant.
defaultPrompt: Use $jd to split this goal into PRDs, delegate it, review it, and continue until verified completion.
